findings.finding: 200-00129 and 200-00132A are the expungement counterparts of the sealing forms 200-00130 and 200-00132, and carry the same widget names.
findings.consequence: The policy assignments are the same assignments, restated against the expungement binaries and their own coordinates rather than shared across a lane boundary. 600-00228 is the same form in both packets and its policy is unchanged.

findings.finding: Every caption in this map is read out of the pinned binary at build time rather than transcribed.
findings.consequence: The caption a participant reads is the text actually printed beside their blank. The guard against a changed form is the exact SHA-256 source binding, which fails the family closed on any byte.

findings.finding: 200-00129 asks one question 200-00130 does not: question 2(d), whether the conduct is no longer prohibited by law.
findings.consequence: That is the ground of this route and it is a sworn assertion about the participant's own offence, so both boxes are left for the participant and the instructions say so in terms. It is not treated as an election the route determines.

findings.finding: 600-00228 is a financial affidavit and the platform holds none of its figures.
findings.consequence: 112 blanks across the packet are required-before-filing and every one is named in participant-instructions.md.
